SUPERIOR COURT

MIDDLESEX COUNTY
DOCKET NO. F00711625
FEDERAL HOME LOAN MORTGAGE
CORPORATION, AS TRUSTEE FOR
THE BENEFIT OF THE FREDDIE MAC
SEASONED CREDIT RISK TRANSFER
TRUST, SERIES 2018-3, is the Plaintiff, and LUIS LINARES, ET ALS., are Defendants, writ of execution for the sale of mortgaged premises dated 11/24/2025.
By virtue of the above stated Writ,
to me directed and delivered, I will
expose to sale at public vendue on
WEDNESDAY, the 11TH DAY of
FEBRUARY A.D. 2026, at the hour of
one thirty o' clock by the then
prevailing (Standard or Daylight
Saving) time, in the afternoon of
the said day, at the Heldrich Hotel,
10 Livingston Ave, New Brunswick,
N.J. 08901.
The property to be sold is located
in the BORO OF SAYREVILLE, County
of Middlesex and State of New Jersey.
Premises commonly known as: 39
WOODS EDGE COURT UNIT 404,
PARLIN, NJ 08859.
Tax Lot: 6.09, Tax Block: 449 CO404,
Dimensions of Lot: Together with
an Undivded 1.1628 Percent Interest in the LA MER IIB ASSOCIATION Condominium.
Nearest Cross Street: NATHAN BLVD.
Estimated upset bid amount:
$197,000.00 plus any additional
sums as ordered by the court.
Occupancy Status: Owner Occupied.
THE SHERIFF HEREBY RESERVES
THE RIGHT TO ADJOURN THIS SALE
WITHOUT FURTHER NOTICE
THROUGH PUBLICATION.
*SUBJECT TO ANY UNPAID TAXES,
MUNICIPAL LIENS OR OTHER
CHARGES, AND ANY SUCH TAXES,
CHARGES, LIENS, INSURANCE
PREMIUMS OR OTHER ADVANCES
MADE BY PLAINTIFF PRIOR TO THIS
SALE. ALL INTERESTED PARTIES ARE
TO CONDUCT AND RELY UPON
THEIR OWN INDEPENDENT INVESTIGATION TO ASCERTAIN WHETHER OR NOT ANY OUTSTANDING INTEREST REMAIN OF RECORD AND/OR HAVE PRIORITY OVER THE LIEN BEING FORECLOSED AND, IF SO THE CURRENT AMOUNT DUE THEREON.
2026 Qtr 1 Due: 02/01/2026 $2,297.06 OPEN
2026 Qtr 2 Due: 05/01/2026 $2.297.05 OPEN
Water: Sayreville Water Dept. 167
Main Street Sayreville, NJ 08872.
732-390-7060 Acct: 82120039 0 To:
11/03/2025 $45.37 OPEN AND DUE
01/02/2026.
Sewer: Sayreville Sewer Dept. 167
Main Street Sayreville, NJ 08872
732-390-7060 Acct: 82120039 0 To:
11/03/2025 $77.61 OPEN AND DUE
01/02/2026.
Vacant Lot Charge: This property is
listed as a vacant/abandoned property per the borough of Sayreville.
At this time registration fees are
not billed. Please contact clerk's
office 732-390-7024 for more information.
PROSPECTIVE PURCHASERS ARE ON
NOTICE THAT THE CONDOMINIUM
ASSOCIATION MAY BE ENTITLED TO
LIMITED PRIORITY PURSUANT TO
STATUTE.
SURPLUS MONEY: if after the sale
and satisfaction of the mortgage
debt, including costs and expenses,
there remains any surplus money,
the money will be deposited Into
the Superior Court Trust Fund and
any person claiming the surplus, or
any part thereof, may file a motion
pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and
4:57-2 stating the nature and
extent of that person's claim and
asking for an order directing
payment of the surplus money. The
Sheriff or other person conducting
the sale will have information
regarding the surplus, if any.
The approximate amount of the
upset to be satisfied by said sale is
the sum of ONE HUNDRED SEVENTY
NINE THOUSAND FOUR HUNDRED
NINETY NINE DOLLARS AND SIXTY
CENTS ($179,499.60) dollars more
or less, plus interest together with
the costs of this sale. THE UPSET
AMOUNT MAY BE SUBJECT TO
FURTHER ORDERS OF ADDITIONAL SUMS.
The subscriber reserves the right to
adjourn said sale from time to time
subject only to such limitations or
restrictions upon the exercise of
such power as may be specially
provided by law or rules of the
Court, Sold subject to conditions of sale.
Successful bidder must pay 20% of
bid in certified check or official bank check at
close of sale and the balance in two weeks.
Mildred S. Scott, Sheriff
Robertson, Anschutz, Schneid,
Crane & Partners, PLLC
130 Clinton Road Ste 202
Fairfield, NJ 07004
Attorneys
